about: The component tokens the Appearance page's looks and advanced editor can change: the sizes, fonts, colours and corners of the parts of the interface. The values the built-in looks give them (Compact, Comfortable) are in the looks themselves, in modules/formulize/include/appearance_looks/. A token's Default is not here: it is the value the CSS declares (modules/formulize/templates/css/formulize-ui.css, or a theme's own tokens). Each token's type says how its values are written in CSS; the token's own min and max (in the type's steps), or its list of values, are what it can be set to, chosen so that every value in the range changes how things look. Read by modules/formulize/include/appearance_tokens.php. The screens, components and gaps are for the advanced editor (modules/formulize/appearance_editor.php): the sample screens a theme can provide, the parts of the interface that can be selected in them and the tokens of each part, and what can't be adjusted yet. A part with a site setting is one of the Appearance page's own settings rather than a set of tokens (the logo). A colour token's value is one of the site's colours (colours) or #rrggbb; its text says it is a text colour. A token's derived are the tokens written from it when it is set, %s being its value. A token's phone is the token used for it at 768px and below; its home is the part a shared token belongs to; its floor is the least it can be given another token's value (one line of a text token at a line height, plus extra px; or another token plus a number of steps).

spacing.description: A number of spacing steps (--fz-spacing, 0.25rem), in half steps.

text.description: A step of the text scale.

leading.description: A line height, as a multiple of the text size.

font.description: The font a kind of text is set in: the main font (--fz-font-sans) or the secondary font (--fz-font-heading), as the Appearance page sets them.

colour.description: A colour: one of the site's colours, by its name in colours below, which follows the Appearance page's colours; or a colour of its own, as #rrggbb.

radius.description: A corner radius, in px. 999 is fully rounded, for a token whose full is true.

logo.name: Logo
logo.plural: the logo at the top of every page

page.name: Page
gaps: The top bar height and the sidebar width.
Sidebar menu items.

tabs.name: Page tabs
tabs.plural: the page tabs of every multi-page form
gaps: The space between tabs, and below the tab strip.
The drawer's page tabs.

title.name: Title
title.plural: every form card, list and drawer title
gaps: Letter spacing.
Headings inside text elements and screen templates.

form.name: Form card
gaps: The space between form cards.
Card padding at phone widths, which is fixed.
The card's shadow.

label.name: Field label
gaps: The label column width in two-column forms (20%).

field.name: Form field
field.plural: every text box, dropdown and text area
gaps: A text area's starting height (2.4 times the field height).
File upload, slider, colour picker and date picker controls.
The focus ring, which follows Primary.

options.name: Choice options
options.plural: every set of radio buttons and checkboxes
gaps: The size of the radio button and checkbox.
Choice options in screen templates built with Formulize UI's fz-choice-group, which keep their own spacing.

button.name: Button
gaps: Small and large buttons, which keep their own sizes.
The selection bar's buttons (fixed at 28px).
Icon sizes.
Hover colours: the main button's is a darker shade of its own colour, and the others' are the theme's.
Danger buttons, which follow Danger.

toolbar.name: Toolbar
toolbar.plural: the title bar, selection bar and footer of every list, and the action bar of every form
gaps: Their top and bottom padding.
Their height and padding at phone widths, which are fixed.
Pagination buttons.

menu.name: Menu item
menu.plural: every item in a dropdown menu
gaps: The menu's width and padding.
The selected item, which follows Primary.

header.name: Column headings
header.plural: the heading row of every list and table
gaps: The sort arrows.
The search and filter row under the headings.

row.name: List row
row.plural: every row in every list and table
gaps: Top and bottom cell padding: only the height is set, and the content is centred in it.
Rows grow to fit their content: a cell with several lines, a list of values or an edit icon makes its row taller than the row height.
The checkbox column width.
Badges and other things inside cells.
Selected rows, which follow Primary.

card.name: Card
card.plural: every Formulize UI card (fz-card), in screen templates and custom code
gaps: The space between cards in a card list or grid, which is set by its gap class.
The card's shadow.

drawer.name: Drawer
gaps: The drawer's width.
Its padding at phone widths, which is fixed.
The footer's side padding, which matches its top and bottom padding.
Shadows, everywhere, and the colours of anything not listed under a part.
Fonts other than the main and secondary fonts, for a part.
Small and large buttons, and the selection bar's buttons.
Phone-width spacing (title bar, cards, drawer), which is fixed.
The 44px minimum height of fields and buttons on phones.
Checkboxes, radio buttons, switches and badges.
Filter chips, pagination, the sidebar and the top bar.
Dialogs, date pickers and subform tables.
